answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 9335 Country: India Title: My Father passed away in an accident in the month of Ramadan. I saw a dream that I and My mother roaming outside the airport on a raod and My mother tells me to get some water..when I go out to get water, My Father comes in a Car and he is smiling at me and He takes me and my mother in his Car and we Come Home in the car. Question: My Father passed away in an accident in the month of Ramadan. I saw a dream that I and My mother roaming outside the airport on a raod and My mother tells me to get some water..when I go out to get water, My Father comes in a Car and he is smiling at me and He takes me and my mother in his Car and we Come Home in the car. Answer ID: 9335 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1647/290=TL/1429) It indicates that the condition of your father is nice. However, you should keep on doing isal-e-thawab for him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
